_comment_hyperparameters: Only keys in ALLOWED_OVERRIDES are honoured. Anything else is echoed back in result.json under rejected_overrides rather than silently ignored — an override the caller thinks is in effect but isn't is worse than a refusal.
_comment_max_steps: Optional. Overrides num_epochs; used by smoke tests to keep a run to a handful of steps.
_comment_resume: Set to a checkpoint path under /out/run to resume. The orchestrator sets this on retry after a preemption or crash.
